rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a brotherly bond or sense of solidarity.

example.english: We’ve been friends for so many years, and our brotherhood is still there.
example.traditional: 我哋咁多年朋友，兄弟情一直都喺度。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam3 do1 nin4 pang4 jau5 hing1 dai6 cing4 jat1 zik6 dou1 hai2 dou6

rows.note: Use this when you mean the literal relationship or status between brothers.

example.english: The brotherhood between those two brothers has always been pretty good.
example.traditional: 佢哋兩兄弟關係一向都幾好。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 hing1 dai6 gwaan1 hai6 jat1 hoeng3 dou1 gei2 hou2

rows.note: Use this for an organized fraternity or brotherhood association rather than a personal bond.

example.english: This brotherhood holds a gathering every month.
example.traditional: 呢個兄弟會每個月都有聚會。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hing1 dai6 wui2 mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 jau5 zeoi6 wui2
